715210101.text: The next painting is... Right. It's this one...

715210104.text: I heard so much about you from my colleagues and was wondering if you would grace this grand event.

715210105.text: And as luck would have it, here you are! It is truly an honor to meet you!

715210106.text: There are many things I wish to introduce to you, but before that, allow me to introduce myself.

715210107.text: I am Batlo, a painter... You should be quite familiar with this profession, no?

715210108.text: But in addition to being a painter myself, I am also an art conservator.

715210109.text: No matter what type of damage a painting has suffered, whether it was burnt, chewed on by rodents, rotted by mold, or any similar matter...

715210110.text: As long as it is in my hands, I can restore the painting to its original, most perfect state!

715210111.text: Restoring paintings... Do you just repaint them?

715210112.text: Hahaha! Of course not. Were I to just repaint them exactly as they were, that would be called "copying."

715210113.text: What we art conservators must do is restore a piece of artwork to its most original pristine condition.

715210114.text: Every detail, from the colors to the brushstrokes... Even the material of the canvas itself must be exactly the same as the original painting.

715210117.text: Isn't it? It takes exceptional painting skill, as well as uncommonly keen and detailed image perception.

715210118.text: Which is why... I simply haven't been able to hire many capable assistants.

715210119.text: I mean, if a painter has both exceptional skills and a keen perception of the smallest details...

715210120.text: Then why not just focus on their own work instead of helping restore that of other artists?

715210121.text: Not to mention how this job doesn't pay well, and how people often think of us as a bunch of copycats with mediocre skills...

715210122.text: But every job needs to be done by someone, wouldn't you agree?

715210123.text: Art is a precious thing. An outstanding painting can carry history, stories, and emotions... and of course its market value.

715210124.text: No matter what others think, as an artist myself, I will not stand idly by and watch those paintings deteriorate.

715210125.text: But... as I just said, this job doesn't pay well, and is often misunderstood.

715210126.text: Though I've been busy trying to recruit assistants, as you can see, as of now I'm still the only one doing the job.

715210127.text: That's why I'm here today. I want to educate people about what an art conservator does, and perhaps I'll be able to recruit a few more people this way.

715210128.text: However... Though I've yet to find an assistant, I have received numerous commissions to restore ancient paintings.

715210129.text: These old paintings come from Mondstadt and Liyue. They include landscapes, figures, animals, and even... crayon drawings from children...

715210131.text: Uh... In principle, as long as it's a painting, it's a valid commission.

715210132.text: Besides, even a child's crayon drawing contains the hard work they poured into it. Who is to say it may not be their first step to becoming an artist one day?

715210133.text: So, it's understandable that their parents would come to me for to restore it.
